description_en: Lists the user synchronization tasks in a specified user pool
description_zh: 分页列出指定用户池下的用户同步任务
name: ListUserPoolSyncJobs

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1~1000，默认值：100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token。首次查询不传，后续从上一次响应的 NextToken 获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the user pool
parameters.name: user_pool_name

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page for the current request

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页 Token。为空表示没有更多数据

items.description_en: The details of the synchronization task

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the synchronization

IdentityProviderType.description_en: The type of the identity provider

JobSummary.description_en: The statistics information of the synchronization results

Created.description_en: The statistics of created users in JSON format. It includes the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Created.description_zh: 新建用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

Deleted.description_en: The statistics of deleted users in JSON format. It includes the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Deleted.description_zh: 删除用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

Same.description_en: The statistics of unchanged users in JSON format. It includes the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Same.description_zh: 无变化用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

Updated.description_en: The statistics of updated users in JSON format. It includes the following four fields: total (total count), success (success count), failed (failure count), and skipped (skipped count)
Updated.description_zh: 更新用户统计，JSON 格式，包含 total（总数）、success（成功数）、failed（失败数）、skipped（跳过数）四个字段

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the synchronization

Status.description_en:
The status of the synchronization task. Valid values:

Pending: The initial state.

Running: The task is running.

Failed: The task failed.

PartialSuccess: The task partially succeeded.

Success: The task succeeded
Status.description_zh:
同步任务状态，取值可选范围：

Pending：初始状态

Running：运行中

Failed：失败

PartialSuccess：部分成功

Success：成功

SynchronizationJobId.description_en: The ID of the synchronization task

TriggerType.description_en: The trigger type of the synchronization task. Valid values: Manual (manually triggered). Currently, only manual triggering is supported
TriggerType.description_zh: 同步任务的触发类型。取值：Manual（手动触发）。当前仅支持手动触发

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of synchronization tasks that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合条件的同步任务总数
